SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_POWER_SOLO.title: Tank
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_POWER_SOLO.descrip: Takes 50% more damage from enemies. Reflects all blocked Attack damage back at the attacker.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK_POWER_SOL: Takes double damage this turn from Attack cards that were not in hand when this was applied.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH_POWER_SOLO.desc: Gains Block whenever damage is dealt by means other than an Attack card.
Whenever you play Sovereign Blade, replay every card that Forged this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GENEROUS_GIFT_POWER_SOL: At the start of your next turn, add a random Colorless card to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONSTELLATION_POWER_SOL: At the start of your next turn, draw a card, gain Energy, and gain Block.
